Defender 90 (L663) D300 3.0 I6 MHEV diesel, 3-door SWB, EU/DE. Kerb 2316 kg, GVWR 2970 kg (ADAC). Axle limits not published. Source: adac.de Autokatalog.

Defender 110 (L663) D300 3.0 I6 MHEV diesel, 5-door, EU/UK. Kerb from cars-data, GVW 3175 kg standard L663 110, rear axle ~1900 kg (owner/forum); front axle not sourced. Source: cars-data.com / Land Rover L663 tech spec.
Hilux Double Cab 2.8 D-4D 4WD Invincible, EU/UK. GVW 3210 kg, kerb ~2212 kg, payload ~1010 kg. Axle limits not published. Source: ultimatespecs.com / Toyota UK tech specs.
Patrol GU/Y61 LWB Wagon 4.8 petrol, AU / Middle East (Y61 long out of EU sale). GVM 3060 kg standard; kerb ~2300 kg (trim-dependent). Source: statewide4x4.com.au / patrol4x4.com.

2023+ Ranger Wildtrak Double Cab 2.0 EcoBlue bi-turbo auto 4x4, EU/UK. GVW 3280 kg, kerb ~2388 kg, payload ~985 kg. EU axle split not published (AU-only). Source: UK Ford Ranger spec sheet / ultimatespecs.com.
Wrangler JL 2-door (short wheelbase) 2.2 MultiJet diesel Rubicon, EU. Kerb 1990 kg, GVWR 2415 kg. Axle limits not published. Source: auto-data.net.
Wrangler JL Unlimited 2.2 MultiJet diesel Rubicon (4-door), EU. Kerb 2122 kg, GVWR 2630 kg (low payload headroom). Axle limits not published. Source: automoli.com / ultimatespecs.com.
T6.1 panel van 2.0 TDI, 3200 kg (T32) class, EU/UK. GVWR range 2.8–3.2 t; kerb ~2000 kg estimated for heavier build. Axle maxima from SwissVans weight guide. Source: vehiclesizes.com / swissvans.com.
Sprinter 319 CDI 4WD panel van, 3500 kg GVWR class, EU. Kerb 2125 kg, payload ~1675 kg (heavier-GVWR variants exist). Axle limits not listed. Source: truck1.eu technical data.
2020 4Runner TRD Off-Road 4WD, US market (NOT sold in EU). Curb 4400 lb = 1996 kg, GVWR 6100 lb = 2767 kg. No clean front/rear GAWR split published. Source: cars.com specs.

Jimny GJ 1.5 (3-door, 4-seat), EU. GVWR 1435 kg, axles 680 front / 880 rear; kerb ~1135 kg (sources span 1075–1165 kg). Very small payload — easy to overload. Source: carfolio.com / German Jimny GJ data.
Jimny XL 5-door 1.5 petrol (launched Dec 2023), M/T. Kerb 1185 kg, GVM 1545 kg (Suzuki AU official; EU body equivalent). Axle limits not published. Source: suzuki.com.au specifications.
LR4/Disco4 3.0 TDV6, EU/UK (~2009–2016). Kerb 2583 kg, GVM 3240 kg (varies ~2538–2670 kg by trim). Axle limits not sourced. Source: ultimatespecs.com / aulro.com.
Discovery Series II 2.5 Td5 ES, EU/UK (~1998–2004). Kerb 2255 kg; GVW 2880 kg (7-seat/self-levelling; coil-spring 5-seat 2750 kg). Axle limits not sourced. Source: parkers.co.uk / aulro.com.

Classic Defender 110 Station Wagon (Td5/300Tdi), EU/EEC (pre-2016). EEC kerb ~2055 kg (incl. fuel + 75 kg); GVW 2950 kg, front 1200 / rear 1750 (Utility variants 3050/1850). Source: Land Rover workshop manual EEC kerb-weight tables.

80 Series 4.2 turbo-diesel HDJ80 (1HD), EU/intl (~1990–1997). Kerb 2296 kg, max permissible 2960 kg (kerb varies ~2200–2425 kg; later-spec GVM up to ~3060 kg). Axle limits not sourced. Source: auto-data.net.
Prado J150 facelift 2.8 D-4D, EU. Kerb 2165 kg (base 5-seat), GVW 2990 kg; heavier 7-seat trims ~2560 kg kerb / 3150 kg GVW — varies by market/trim. Axle limits not sourced. Source: auto-data.net.
Pajero IV 3.2 DI-D 5-door, EU. Kerb 2405 kg, GVW 3030 kg (earlier IV ~2265 kg kerb — varies by trim/year). Axle splits not published. Source: encycarpedia.com / auto-data.net.
G 350 d W463 (facelift 2018, 286 hp), EU. Kerb 2376 kg, permissible gross 3150 kg, max load 774 kg. Per-axle limits not listed. Source: auto-data.net EU homologation.

Classic XJ 4.0 (1984–2001), US figures converted (0.4536). Curb ~3605 lb = 1635 kg, GVWR ~4900 lb = 2223 kg (curb varies 3100–3600 lb by config). Axle GAWR not reliably published. Source: encycarpedia.com / door-plate reports.
Niva / Niva Legend 1.7i 3-door, EU/RU. Kerb 1210 kg, gross 1610 kg, payload 400 kg. Axle splits not published. Source: auto-data.net / encycarpedia.com.

3rd-gen Tacoma TRD Off-Road Double Cab 4x4 (2018), US market (NOT EU-sold), converted (0.4536). Curb ~4425 lb = 2007 kg, GVWR ~5600 lb = 2540 kg. Axle splits not published. Source: jdpower.com / kbb.com.
